name: Screen Shake / Camera Quake
timing_behavior: Instantaneous trigger; stacks when called multiple times in consecutive frames.
authoring_guide: Use during boss stomps, door explosions, and collapsing ceilings. Often chained with sound_effect 0x15.

name: Camera Interpolation Reset
timing_behavior: Smoothly re-centers the camera directly behind the character facing angle.
authoring_guide: Use after dialogue finishes to smoothly align the player's view with their forward direction without snapping.

name: Camera Zoom In
timing_behavior: Adjusts camera zoom closer to target entity.
authoring_guide: Ideal for dramatic NPC close-up dialogues.

name: Camera Zoom Out
timing_behavior: Adjusts camera zoom further from target entity.
authoring_guide: Ideal for widening perspective during boss introductions or arena showcases.

name: Cinematic Camera Pan
register_payload_layout: regsA[0-2]: Destination XYZ coordinates (integers); regsA[3]: Duration in frames (e.g. 180 = 6 sec); regsA[4]: Pan curve/speed mode.
timing_behavior: Interpolates smoothly across the designated number of frames.
assembly_example:
leti r60, 0x000000DF   // Target X
leti r61, 0x0000001B   // Target Y
leti r62, 0xFFFFFE5B   // Target Z
leti r63, 0x000000B4   // 180 frames (6 sec)
leti r64, 0x0000001E   // Interpolation mode
cam_pan r60-r64
authoring_guide: The standard way to sweep across a room, showcase an unlocked door, or track an incoming wave.

name: Player-Relative Camera Positioning
register_payload_layout: regsA[0-2]: Unused / Target offset; regsA[3-5]: Relative XYZ location of camera from player.
timing_behavior: Applies immediately for the current perspective mode.
assembly_example:
leti r70, 0
leti r71, 0
leti r72, 0
leti r73, 0
leti r74, 50   // 50 units above
leti r75, -120 // 120 units behind
pcam_param r70-r75
authoring_guide: Used to construct custom over-the-shoulder or cinematic third-person viewpoints relative to the player model.

name: Fixed World Camera (Integer Coordinates)
register_payload_layout: regsA[0-2]: Camera eye location XYZ (integers); regsA[3-5]: Camera look-at target XYZ (integers).
timing_behavior: Locks camera to fixed world position until default_camera_pos1/2 is invoked.
assembly_example:
leti r60, 150  // Eye X
leti r61, 40   // Eye Y
leti r62, -200 // Eye Z
leti r63, 0    // Focus X
leti r64, 10   // Focus Y
leti r65, 0    // Focus Z
leti_fixed_camera r60-r65
authoring_guide: Used for stationary conversation cameras and security monitor perspective cutscenes in DC/PC/GC quests.

name: Restore Default Camera Control (Ver.1-2)
timing_behavior: Immediately releases fixed camera locks and returns camera tracking to player controls.
authoring_guide: Must be invoked at the end of any cutscene or locked camera sequence.

name: Fixed World Camera (Floating Point Coordinates)
register_payload_layout: regsA[0-2]: Camera eye location XYZ (floats); regsA[3-5]: Camera look-at target XYZ (floats).
timing_behavior: Locks camera to precise sub-unit floating-point coordinates in 3D world space.
assembly_example:
fleti r230, 901.74   // Eye X
fleti r231, 19.66    // Eye Y
fleti r232, -873.47  // Eye Z
fleti r233, 909.17   // Focus X
fleti r234, 16.68    // Focus Y
fleti r235, -855.14  // Focus Z
arg_pushb 0xE6
fleti_fixed_camera r230-r235
authoring_guide: The standard modern PSOBB cinematic camera instruction. Provides ultra-smooth, jitter-free positioning.

name: Player-Locked Angled Camera (Floats)
register_payload_layout: valueA: Client/Player ID; regsB[0-2]: Fixed camera angles (Pitch, Yaw, Roll as floats).
timing_behavior: Maintains fixed angular orientation while following player translation.
assembly_example:
arg_pushl 0x00000000 // Player ID
fleti r100, 25.0     // Pitch down
fleti r101, 180.0    // Facing angle
fleti r102, 0.0      // Roll
fleti_locked_camera 0, r100-r102
authoring_guide: Used for top-down dungeon crawler perspectives or classic isometric camera locks in custom quests.

name: Restore Default Camera Control (BB/V4)
timing_behavior: Releases floating-point fixed cameras and restores normal player camera handling.
authoring_guide: The canonical PSOBB termination opcode for cutscene scripts.
